audience: operations and DevOps teams that run uptime checks and log searches in Sematext

useCases.title: See which Synthetics monitors are failing
useCases.text: Find the Synthetics app, then list its monitors with their status. Open one monitor to see its last failed result and locations.

useCases.title: Search log events for errors
useCases.text: Search a Logs app with a query string, for example for one status code on one host. Pass the Logs token of that app for each search.

useCases.title: Count log events by status code
useCases.text: Send a query DSL body with filters, ranges and aggregations. Use it to count the events for each status code.

useCases.title: Run a monitor now from chosen locations
useCases.text: Start a check run of one or more monitors from the location ids you choose. Each run uses your check quota, then read the result.
